summary: Environment A evidence for two fixes triggered by nine real Windows pilot screenshots of the Phase 14 artifact: the Live Transcript panel frozen at the same six lines across several minutes of visible video progress (a real side effect of Phase 14's own placeholder-discard fix), and a request that CIP detect Scripture even when paraphrased without a book name. See docs/phase-15-audit.md for the full root-cause investigation.
trigger: Nine real Windows pilot screenshots of the Phase 14 installer, taken minutes apart while a YouTube sermon played through the laptop's own speakers and was picked up by its own microphone. The Live Transcript panel shows the exact same six lines, frozen at 19:36:54, in every photo despite the video's own captions and playback timer clearly advancing between screenshots. The operator also reported an input level around 5% and asked that CIP detect Scripture even when paraphrased and no book name is spoken.

premiseVerification.claim1_transcript_can_go_fully_silent: Confirmed via direct code trace: ai/speech/src/whisper.rs::run_inference returns Ok(vec![]) for a placeholder-discarded window (Phase 14's own fix); commands.rs::handle_audio_chunk's `for segment in segments` loop is the only call site for both Bible detection and the 12-20s segmenter accumulator, so it never executes for that window; segmentation.rs::TranscriptSegmenter::push never starts its 15s span clock until it receives non-empty text, so a sustained placeholder-only stretch leaves the accumulator - and thus the Live Transcript panel - frozen indefinitely with zero operator-visible signal.
premiseVerification.claim2_freshness_signal_already_existed_: Confirmed service.rs::transcript_freshness (TRANSCRIPT_STALE_AFTER_SECONDS = 30) was already computed and already polled into the frontend's serviceIntel state on every status refresh, but was only ever rendered in the Service Intelligence section further down LiveChurchBrain.tsx, never next to the Live Transcript panel itself where the screenshots show the operator was actually looking.
premiseVerification.claim3_bible_detection_is_raw_window_onl: Confirmed finalize_bible_only's own doc comment ('Bible detection's only live-audio entry point' since Phase 4.3) and traced route_segment_to_live_intelligence_engines to confirm it routes only to Sermon/Service/Music, never Bible - the accumulated 12-20s window never gets a Bible detection pass under the pre-Phase-15 code.
premiseVerification.claim4_none_of_the_six_reported_lines_ar: Reviewed all six visible transcript lines ('understand the Word of God', 'starting the Bible is inevitable if you have', etc.) - all are meta-commentary about Bible study, not paraphrases of any specific verse's content, so no correct implementation (before or after this phase) would have matched them to a reference. The real, fixable gap is reduced odds of catching a genuine paraphrase from a single ~3s fragment's limited vocabulary, not a defect exposed by these specific lines.

designChoice: A fuller-context retry (paraphrase/semantic fallbacks only, never citation detection) runs once an accumulated 12-20s window closes, but only when none of its own raw ~3s sub-windows already found a suggestion - reusing the exact same try_paraphrase/try_semantic functions and thresholds already in use, never loosening them. The stall indicator repeats an already-existing, already-tested, already-polled freshness value directly under the Live Transcript panel rather than inventing a new signal or fabricating placeholder transcript content.

newCode.coreService: core/service/src/bible_intelligence.rs: new retry_paraphrase_or_semantic_with_fuller_context (pure, calls only try_paraphrase/try_semantic, never detect_candidates).
newCode.pipelineRs: apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/pipeline.rs: extracted persist_detections_and_suggestions (shared by handle_final_transcript_inner and the new retry_paraphrase_or_semantic_with_fuller_context entry point, which never re-persists the transcript segment row).
newCode.commandsRs: apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/commands.rs: finalize_bible_only now returns bool; new finalize_bible_fuller_context_retry; a per-listening-session window_had_suggestion flag owned by spawn_speech_worker, reset on every window flush and on the overload-discard segmenter reset.
newCode.frontend: LiveChurchBrain.tsx: the Live Transcript panel repeats the already-existing transcriptFreshness signal directly under the transcript list when stale (>=30s).

newTests.testingBoundaryNote: retry_paraphrase_or_semantic_with_fuller_context is pure and fully tested (finds a paraphrase a short fragment alone would miss, never produces a citation detection, never mutates context, falls through to semantic when lexical finds nothing). The commands.rs wiring is thin orchestration mirroring silent_windows_skipped's own already-established untested-directly precedent - no dedicated integration test was added. The frontend change only displays an already-tested, already-polled value - no new frontend test was added, mirroring Phase 13's own precedent of skipping a redundant render test for a section that only surfaces already-tested data.

fullRegression.frontend: npm run typecheck/lint/test/build: all clean - same 5 pre-existing lint warnings, no new ones

architecturalSafetyNotes: Zero new Tauri commands, zero new events, zero new migrations - the fuller-context retry reuses finalize_and_route_segment's already-persisted accumulated segment row; the stall indicator reuses an already-existing, already-polled command's output.

retry_paraphrase_or_semantic_with_fuller_context can never attempt citation detection or mutate DefaultScriptureContextManager - it calls only try_paraphrase/try_semantic under the same 'only when nothing else already found a suggestion' gating process_transcript_segment_inner already uses.
persist_detections_and_suggestions's extraction is a pure refactor - handle_final_transcript_inner's own behavior for the raw-window path is byte-for-byte unchanged.
core/bible, core/sermon, core/music, core/presentation (every domain contract crate this phase does not touch) are entirely untouched.
honestLimitation: The fuller-context retry raises the odds of catching a genuine paraphrase that needs more than one raw window's worth of vocabulary, but it is still bounded by the same lexical-overlap/semantic-similarity thresholds as before - a paraphrase sharing almost no vocabulary with its verse still needs the semantic fallback, which still needs an operator-provisioned embedding model never verified on real hardware. The stall indicator explains that nothing new has been transcribed and offers the most likely honest reason (a quiet/unclear microphone signal) - it cannot diagnose every possible cause with more precision than the underlying transcript_freshness signal already could.
environmentCStatus: NOT YET VERIFIED for this exact artifact - the decisive pending gate is a second real pilot session confirming the Live Transcript panel now surfaces a clear 'no new transcript' message instead of silently freezing during a long quiet/unclear stretch, and that a genuine paraphrase spoken without a book name is now more likely to be caught - see physicalHardwareStatement item 24.
